mapper.sql: id, slug, title, summary, body_md, site_url, repo_url, year, sort_order, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM works ORDER BY sort_order, year DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM works ORDER BY sort_order, year DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO works (slug, title, summary, body_md, site_url, repo_url, year, sort_order) VALUES (#{slug}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{bodyMd}, #{siteUrl}, #{repoUrl}, #{year}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE works SET slug = #{slug}, title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, body_md = #{bodyMd}, site_url = #{siteUrl}, repo_url = #{repoUrl}, year = #{year}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
